+from typing import Optional
+import discord
+from discord import app_commands
+
+import traceback
+
+# The guild in which this slash command will be registered.
+# It is recommended to have a test guild to separate from your "production" bot
+TEST_GUILD = discord.Object(0)
+# The user ID of the bot owner. This is used to restrict access to the command.
+BOT_OWNER_ID = 0  # Replace with your user ID
+
+
+class MyClient(discord.Client):
+    # Suppress error on the User attribute being None since it fills up later
+    user: discord.ClientUser
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        # Just default intents and a `discord.Client` instance
+        # We don't need a `commands.Bot` instance because we are not
+        # creating text-based commands.
+        intents = discord.Intents.default()
+        super().__init__(intents=intents)
+
+        # We need an `discord.app_commands.CommandTree` instance
+        # to register application commands (slash commands in this case)
+        self.tree = app_commands.CommandTree(self)
+
+    async def on_ready(self):
+        print(f'Logged in as {self.user} (ID: {self.user.id})')
+        print('------')
+
+    async def setup_hook(self) -> None:
+        # Sync the application command with Discord.
+        await self.tree.sync(guild=TEST_GUILD)
+
+
+class BotUpdateModal(discord.ui.Modal, title='Set Bot Avatar & Banner'):
+    # We can use a Label to attach a rich label and description to our item.
+    avatar = discord.ui.Label(
+        text='Avatar',
+        description='The new avatar for the bot. Optional.',
+        component=discord.ui.FileUpload(
+            max_values=1,  # The maximum number of files that can be uploaded
+            required=False,
+        ),
+    )
+
+    banner = discord.ui.Label(
+        text='Banner',
+        description='The new banner for the bot. Optional.',
+        component=discord.ui.FileUpload(
+            max_values=1,
+            required=False,
+        ),
+    )
+
+    async def on_submit(self, interaction: discord.Interaction[MyClient]):
+        # We defer the response because updating the avatar and banner can take a bit of time
+        await interaction.response.defer()
+
+        # Get our bot to update its avatar and banner
+        client = interaction.client
+
+        # Tell the type checker what our components are...
+        assert isinstance(self.avatar.component, discord.ui.FileUpload)
+        assert isinstance(self.banner.component, discord.ui.FileUpload)
+
+        avatar: Optional[discord.Attachment] = self.avatar.component.values[0] if self.avatar.component.values else None
+        banner: Optional[discord.Attachment] = self.banner.component.values[0] if self.banner.component.values else None
+
+        # Update the avatar and banner
+        # We read the bytes from the attachment and pass it to edit
+        # If no file was uploaded, we pass `discord.utils.MISSING`, to not update that field
+        await client.user.edit(
+            avatar=await avatar.read() if avatar else discord.utils.MISSING,
+            banner=await banner.read() if banner else discord.utils.MISSING,
+        )
+
+        # Let the user know it was successful, this is optional
+        await interaction.followup.send(
+            f"Updated {client.user.mention}'s avatar / banner.",
+            ephemeral=True,
+        )
+
+    async def on_error(self, interaction: discord.Interaction, error: Exception) -> None:
+        await interaction.response.send_message('Oops! Something went wrong.', ephemeral=True)
+
+        # Make sure we know what the error actually is
+        traceback.print_exception(type(error), error, error.__traceback__)
+
+
+client = MyClient()
+
+
+@client.tree.command(guild=TEST_GUILD, description="Update the bot's avatar and banner")
+async def update_bot(interaction: discord.Interaction):
+    # Locking this command to the bot owner only
+    # We don't want anyone else changing our bot's avatar and banner!
+    # Realistically, this should be proper checks, but this is just an example.
+    if interaction.user.id != BOT_OWNER_ID:
+        await interaction.response.send_message('You are not the owner of this bot.', ephemeral=True)
+        return

Maybe change it to something akin to "test guild before syncing globally" or similar.
